text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal for commercial boulevard parking from the owner of 226 Lawrence Avenue West. Commercial Boulevard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 743. The Code does not permit licencing of the boulevard for parking where vehicle access is from an arterial road.

North York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for commercial boulevard parking at 226 Lawrence Avenue West. 2. Requested that the owner install barriers to prevent the unauthorized parking to the satisfaction of the General Manager of Transportation Services, as indicated in Attachment 'C', attached to the report (March 25, 2019) from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
